semantics.identity_rule: Each invariant set/profile has explicit identity/version.
semantics.scope_rule: Each invariant declares exact component/contract applicability.
semantics.exception_rule: Any exception must be explicit new semantics rather than an accidental implementation shortcut.
semantics.authority_rule: Invariant set governs semantic conformance, not user authorization.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

hard_gates.condition: invariant evaluated per-file only despite cross-kernel scope
